name: Hobby operating system built with Claude

mentions.name: Hobby operating system built with Claude
mentions.description: A novel hobby operating system developed collaboratively with Claude, where the author acts as stakeholder while Claude writes all code and documentation. It has a UI running on x86_64, Aarch64, and RiscV64 via QEMU, guided by 14 principles for the OS and development process, with migration from emulation to real physical hardware now beginning. The project also serves as a way to learn how to work collaboratively with an AI.
